title: Study of cerebellar function in adult patients with non paretic strabism
summary: It is investigated whether adult patients who consult for strabism surgery show hints  of cerebellar disfunction.

interventions.name: adult patients who consult for strabism surgery

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
aquired strabism in adulthood
Exclusion criteria:
prior eye surgery
trauma
known cerebellar disfunction
pregnancy
